name: Hikobane
source:
"I'll protect you for the rest of my life"

Type: Demon Crow
A creature in a monk outfit, which has a beaked face and black wings that give him the ability to fly.

Favorites: grilled fish (especially salted grilled sweetfish)

One of the four who appeared in front of you when mononokes attacked the castle.
He treats you with courtesy and good manners. But his face is impassive, so it might be difficult to understand him.
There seems to be an emotional distance between you. How will you make him smile?

[From in-game profile]
